name: openssl
summary: The TLS and crypto multitool: inspect TLS services, read and convert certificates and keys, hash, encrypt and derive.

modes.name: s_client
modes.summary: Open a TLS/SSL connection to a server and show the certificate, chain and negotiated parameters.

modes.name: ciphers
modes.summary: List the cipher suites a protocol or cipher string selects.

modes.name: x509
modes.summary: Display, convert, sign and edit X.509 certificates.

modes.name: req
modes.summary: Create and process certificate signing requests and self-signed certificates.

modes.name: verify
modes.summary: Verify a certificate chain against trusted roots.

modes.name: crl
modes.summary: Display and convert certificate revocation lists.

modes.name: genrsa
modes.summary: Generate an RSA private key.

modes.name: rsa
modes.summary: Display, convert and re-encrypt an RSA key.

modes.name: pkey
modes.summary: Display and convert a private or public key of any algorithm.

modes.name: pkeyutl
modes.summary: Sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt and derive with a key.

modes.name: dgst
modes.summary: Hash a file, or compute an HMAC or a signature over it.

modes.name: enc
modes.summary: Symmetric-cipher encrypt or decrypt, with base64 and a passphrase KDF.

modes.name: mac
modes.summary: Compute a MAC (HMAC, CMAC, GMAC, KMAC, Poly1305).

modes.name: passwd
modes.summary: Hash a password in crypt, MD5, SHA-256 or SHA-512 form.

modes.name: rand
modes.summary: Emit cryptographically strong random bytes, in hex or base64.

modes.name: prime
modes.summary: Test a number for primality, or generate a prime.

modes.name: kdf
modes.summary: Derive a key with a KDF (HKDF, PBKDF2, scrypt, ...).

modes.name: pkcs12
modes.summary: Build and parse PKCS#12 (.p12/.pfx) bundles of keys and certificates.

modes.name: pkcs8
modes.summary: Convert private keys to and from PKCS#8 format.

modes.name: asn1parse
modes.summary: Dump the ASN.1 structure of a DER or PEM file.

inputs.label: Key size (bits)
inputs.help: Size of the RSA key in bits, as the trailing argument (default 2048). Withheld during verification.

inputs.label: Cipher string
inputs.help: An OpenSSL cipher string to expand, as the trailing argument. Withheld during verification.

inputs.label: Number
inputs.help: The number to test for primality, as the trailing argument (decimal, or hex with -hex). Withheld during verification.

inputs.label: MAC name
inputs.help: The MAC algorithm: HMAC, CMAC, GMAC, KMAC-128, Poly1305. Withheld during verification.

inputs.label: KDF name
inputs.help: The KDF algorithm: HKDF, PBKDF2, SCRYPT, SSKDF, TLS1-PRF. Withheld during verification.

inputs.label: Password
inputs.help: The password to hash, as the trailing argument (omit to read from a prompt). Withheld during verification.

recipes.name: Inspect a server certificate
recipes.summary: Open a TLS connection and print the full certificate chain the server presents.
recipes.when: First look at any HTTPS or TLS service: what cert, what chain, what issuer.

recipes.name: STARTTLS on a mail service
recipes.summary: Negotiate STARTTLS on an SMTP/IMAP/POP3 port, then inspect the certificate.
recipes.when: The service upgrades to TLS mid-protocol (SMTP 25/587, IMAP 143, POP3 110).

recipes.name: Force a protocol version
recipes.summary: Pin the handshake to one TLS version to see whether the server still allows it.
recipes.when: Checking for legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 support, or confirming TLS 1.3.

recipes.name: Read a certificate
recipes.summary: Print a certificate in human-readable text without re-emitting the certificate.
recipes.when: You have a .pem/.crt on disk and want its subject, SANs, dates and issuer.

recipes.name: Fingerprint and dates
recipes.summary: Print the certificate fingerprint and validity window only.
recipes.when: Pinning a cert, or checking expiry at a glance.

recipes.name: PEM to DER
recipes.summary: Convert a certificate from PEM (base64) to DER (binary).
recipes.when: A tool wants DER, or you want the raw bytes.

recipes.name: Self-signed cert + key
recipes.summary: Generate a fresh key and a self-signed certificate in one command.
recipes.when: Standing up a quick TLS listener for a lab or a callback.

recipes.name: New CSR + key
recipes.summary: Generate a key and a certificate signing request to hand to a CA.
recipes.when: Requesting a signed certificate.

recipes.name: Read a CSR
recipes.summary: Print the contents of a certificate signing request.
recipes.when: Confirming what a CSR actually asks for.

recipes.name: Generate an RSA key
recipes.summary: Write a new RSA private key. Set the size in the trailing box.
recipes.when: You need a private key and nothing fancier.

recipes.name: Inspect an RSA key
recipes.summary: Print the components of an RSA key without re-emitting it.
recipes.when: Checking a key you were handed.

recipes.name: Extract the public key
recipes.summary: Derive the public key from any private key.
recipes.when: You need the public half to share or to pin.

recipes.name: Sign a file
recipes.summary: Produce a signature over a file with a private key.
recipes.when: Signing data or a digest.

recipes.name: HMAC of a file
recipes.summary: Compute a keyed HMAC over a file, printed as hex.
recipes.when: Verifying message integrity with a shared key.

recipes.name: Sign a file
recipes.summary: Hash a file and sign the digest with a private key.
recipes.when: Producing a detached signature.

recipes.name: Encrypt a file
recipes.summary: Symmetric-encrypt a file with a passphrase-derived key and base64 the output.
recipes.when: Protecting a file with a passphrase. Add the cipher with the ad-hoc box (e.g. -aes-256-cbc).

recipes.name: SHA-512 crypt hash
recipes.summary: Hash a password in the /etc/shadow SHA-512 crypt form.
recipes.when: Seeding a Unix password, or cracking practice.

recipes.name: Apache apr1 hash
recipes.summary: Hash a password in the Apache htpasswd (apr1) form.
recipes.when: Writing an .htpasswd entry.

recipes.name: Random hex
recipes.summary: Emit cryptographically strong random bytes as hex. Set the count in the trailing box.
recipes.when: A token, a key, an IV, a nonce.

recipes.name: Generate a prime
recipes.summary: Generate a random prime of a given bit length.
recipes.when: You need a prime for a toy RSA or a CTF.

recipes.name: Bundle key + cert to .p12
recipes.summary: Pack a private key and its certificate into a PKCS#12 file.
recipes.when: Importing into Windows, a browser, or Java.

recipes.name: Extract from a .p12
recipes.summary: Pull the keys and certificates out of a PKCS#12 bundle, unencrypted.
recipes.when: You have a .p12/.pfx and need the PEM parts.

recipes.name: Dump ASN.1 structure
recipes.summary: Walk the ASN.1 structure of a DER or PEM file, field by field.
recipes.when: Understanding an unknown certificate, key or signature blob.

recipes.name: Verify a chain
recipes.summary: Check a certificate against a trusted CA bundle and show the chain.
recipes.when: Confirming whether a cert validates and why it does not.

recipes.name: Read a CRL
recipes.summary: Print a certificate revocation list in text form.
recipes.when: Checking what a CRL revokes and when it next updates.

recipes.name: Expand a cipher string
recipes.summary: Show, verbosely, exactly which cipher suites a string selects.
recipes.when: Working out what a server config actually enables.
